hook: Did you know Kanye West and Ty Dolla Sign face a lawsuit over three versions of Vultures?

sections.voiceover: Did you know Kanye West and Ty Dolla Sign face a lawsuit over three versions of Vultures?
Did Kanye West actually sample their 2018 composition Joint 2 without asking for permission first?
But the producers say they were on a call with Ty when they heard the sample, leading to a studio visit.
They didn't give permission, so the producers filed a three-count complaint in 2026 over three Vultures versions.
Check Bloomberg Law for complete details on case 13035 in the Central District of California.
